question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**encourages**" means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone. (प्रोत्साहित करना)
 
• In the context of student clubs, activities are meant to inspire and nurture students to develop a different perception of life.
 
• The other options**: "simplifies," "confuses," and "diminishes" do not fit the context as appropriately.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Every activity in the club encourages__ students to cultivate a different perception of life.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Simplifies (सरल बनाना)**: means to make something easier to do or understand.
 
• **Confuses (भ्रमित करना)**: means to make someone unable to think clearly.
 
• **Diminishes (कम करना)**: means to make or become less.
